title: Sri Lankan telecom customer churn (synthetic)
provenance: Synthetic Sri Lankan-context data generated by scripts/generate_samples.py (seed 42)
description: One row per customer of a fictional Sri Lankan telecom operator, with usage, billing, complaint and contract information, labelled by whether the customer churned.
context: Uses the 25 districts and 9 provinces of Sri Lanka, LKR charges, and Sinhala/Tamil/English language preference. No real operator or customer is represented.

features.district: District of registration (25 districts, messy case)
features.connection_type: Product type (Mobile Prepaid, Mobile Postpaid, Fibre, 4G Home Broadband, ADSL)
features.monthly_charge_lkr: Monthly charge in LKR (some values stored as 'Rs. 1,250')
features.payment_method: Cash, Card, Mobile wallet, Bank transfer or Reload card
features.late_payments_12m: Late payments in the last 12 months
features.days_since_last_recharge: Days since last recharge or payment
features.disconnection_date: Date of disconnection; only present for churners (LEAKAGE)
features.churned: Target: Yes if the customer churned

target_definition: churned = 'Yes' if the customer left the operator within the observation window.
known_limitations: Synthetic data: relationships are simulated, not measured.
disconnection_date is a planted leakage column and must be excluded.
Results do not describe any real Sri Lankan operator.
anonymisation: Not applicable; no real individuals are represented.
